fusions.name: Bounding Descent
fusions.desc: You leap onto a target up to 7 tiles away at or below 25% health, dealing 20 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full range.

fusions.name: Pogo Stomp
fusions.desc: You bounce in place, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Over Their Heads
fusions.desc: Leaps you instantly to a point up to 8 tiles away, and you move 15% faster for 4 seconds after.

fusions.name: Already Elsewhere
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a blow you failed to dodge rolls your dodge a second time, and the second roll stands.
